# Infrastructure

## Technology stack

| Component | Technology | Version |
|---|---|---|
| Language | TypeScript throughout | 5.8.2 (catalog; desktop pins ~5.6.2) |
| Runtime | Bun | 1.4.2 (root `packageManager`) |
| Core runtime | Effect | 4.0.1 (catalog) |
| HTTP API server | Hono plus Effect HttpApi | Via catalog |
| Terminal UI | SolidJS plus @opentui/core | Via catalog |
| Web app | SolidJS plus Tailwind plus Vite (`packages/app`) | Via catalog |
| Desktop | Electron plus electron-builder (`packages/desktop`) | electron-vite workflow |
| Docs and marketing site | Astro Starlight (`services/www`, `src/docs`) | Via catalog |
| Storage | SQLite via Drizzle ORM plus @effect/sql-sqlite-bun | Via catalog |
| Infrastructure as code | SST | Via catalog |

## Development tooling

| Tool | Purpose | Command |
|---|---|---|
| bun | Package management and script running | `bun install`, `bun run --cwd <package> <script>` |
| oxlint | Linting | `bun run lint` (config `.oxlintrc.json`) |
| ast-grep | Structural lint rules | Part of `bun run lint` (`script/ast-grep/`) |
| tsgo | Type checking, run per package via turbo | `bun run typecheck` from repo root (turbo), or `bun run typecheck` in a package (`tsgo -b`) |
| bun test | Unit testing, always from a package dir, never repo root | `bun run script/test.ts` via package `test` scripts |
| opencode build script | CLI builds | `bun run build` in `packages/cli` |
| husky | Git hooks | Installed via `prepare` script (hooks in `.husky/`) |
| gitleaks | Secret scanning signal | `.gitleaksignore` exists at root |

- Tests must run from package directories, never repo root.
- The root `test` script exits 1 with `do not run tests from root` as a guard.
- Monorepo workspaces are `packages/*`, `services/*`, `packages/console/*`, and `packages/stats/*`.
- Dev entry points from root scripts are `dev` (`packages/cli`), `dev:desktop`, `dev:web` (`packages/app`), `dev:console`, `dev:stats`, and `dev:www` (via service scripts).

## Environments

| Environment | Branch | Purpose | URL |
|---|---|---|---|
| production | production | Live user-facing SST deployment | Exact public URL was not pinned down in this pass |
| dev | dev | Default branch and main integration target | Exact public URL was not pinned down in this pass |
| beta | beta | Pre-release SST deployment | Exact public URL was not pinned down in this pass |

- The default git branch is `dev`.
- SST app name is `opencode` with per-stage behavior.
- Production uses `removal: retain` and `protect: true`, all other stages use `removal: remove`.
- No explicit staging or PR preview environment mapping was found in `sst.config.ts` or `deploy.yml`.

## CI/CD pipelines

- The repo contains 29 workflow files in `.github/workflows/`.
- Workflow files are check, close-issues, close-prs, compliance-close, containers, deploy, deploy-changelog, deploy-files, deploy-posts, deploy-update, deploy-www, docs-locale-sync, docs-update, duplicate-issues, nix-eval, nix-hashes, notify-discord, opencode, pr-management, pr-standards, publish-github-action, publish-vscode, publish, release-github-action, review, stats, storybook, test, and triage.

| Workflow | Trigger | What it runs |
|---|---|---|
| test.yml | Push, pull_request, workflow_dispatch | Unit tests plus Playwright e2e for `packages/app` |
| check.yml | Pull request checks | Lint and typecheck |
| deploy.yml | Push to `dev`, `production`, or `beta`, workflow_dispatch | SST deploy to the matching stage |
| publish.yml | Release pipeline | Version, CLI builds, Electron builds, then publish |
| containers.yml | Container pipeline | Builds images from `packages/containers` |

## Deployment

- SST deployments run through `deploy.yml` on pushes to `dev`, `production`, or `beta` (plus manual dispatch).
- CLI releases run through `publish.yml`, which builds `packages/cli` artifacts for darwin, linux, and windows.
- Desktop builds ship via GitHub releases.
- The npm package `@opencode/cli` is published from the release pipeline.
- A root executable `install` script exists for direct installs.
- Container images are defined in `packages/containers` and published via `containers.yml`.

### Rollback

- No rollback procedure is explicitly documented in the repo.
- SST production uses `removal: retain` with `protect: true`, so a bad deploy is not automatically torn down.
- Reverting a release means cutting a new release or re-running the deploy workflow from a known good ref.

## Health checks

- No dedicated `/health`, `/ready`, `/live`, or `/ping` route was found in `packages/server/src` or `packages/protocol/src` in this pass.
- The public API contract is served at `/openapi.json` (`packages/server/src/routes.ts`).
- The earlier claim of `GET /global/health` could not be verified against the current code and was removed; re-add if a health route is confirmed.

## Smoke tests

- App-level e2e runs via Playwright in `packages/app`, wired into `test.yml`.
- Package test suites run via `bun run script/test.ts` in each package.
- No standalone post-deploy smoke script was found.

## Hosting

- SST home is Cloudflare, with an AWS provider pinned to `us-east-1` (plus Stripe, Planetscale, Honeycomb, and Random providers in `sst.config.ts`).
- The docs site deploys to Cloudflare via the Astro Cloudflare adapter.
- Infrastructure definitions live in `infra/` (`app`, `console`, `enterprise`, `lake`, `monitoring`, `secret`, `stage`, `stats`).
- Scaling strategy was not pinned down in this pass.

## Secrets management

- SST secrets are declared in `infra/secret.ts` (R2 keys, Honeycomb API key and webhook secret, support API key, Upstash Redis URL and token).
- The Stripe provider reads `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY` from the environment in `sst.config.ts`.
- Local development uses environment variables.
